notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes
notes.content:
First of all, we would like to thank all our followers who are playing Recharge! We are carefully reviewing your feedback and reports. We are aware of the optimization issues that have been most frequently mentioned, and we are actively working on resolving them.



During the playtest, the updates we will be releasing will primarily focus on bug fixes and performance improvements, with minor patches being deployed.



Additionally, there may be changes to vehicle physics throughout the playtest. These will be intentional changes made in order to gather feedback.


Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve the game so thank you all again.




Fix: Issue of not detecting input on the login screen

Fix: Race results AI name issue

Customization UI Improved

notes.title: Recharge Demo Update & Upcoming Alpha Test
notes.content:
Hello racers,

First of all, we want to thank you for your incredible support and valuable feedback on the Recharge demo! 🚀 During Steam Next Fest, we launched the demo to showcase the game and gather community feedback. Now, based on your insights, we’re working hard to make the game even better.

Some of you have noticed that the demo is no longer available and have reached out to ask why. To be fully transparent, we originally released the demo in a state that wasn’t perfect, but we didn’t want to miss the opportunity to share it with you during Next Fest. Now that the event is over, we’ve temporarily removed the demo to focus on improvements and development.

But we have exciting news! 🔥 Recharge's Alpha Test is coming soon! If you’re interested in joining the alpha and being among the first to test the latest updates, you can sign up by filling out the form on our Discord.

Join our community here: https://discord.gg/6tykdPkJXF

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!

🏎️ See you on the track! 🏁

notes.title: Demo 0.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
We're rolling out Version 0.1.1, bringing various bug fixes, optimizations, and gameplay improvements! 

Check out the details below, and let us know your thoughts in the discussions section! 💬

[hr] [/hr]
🔹 General Improvements & Optimizations  Optimized Main Menu loading and performance.  Refactored Skatepark environment for better performance.  Improved lighting performance.  Updated Destroy Session Logic to ensure all active sessions are properly terminated.  Implemented Doppler Effect for a more immersive sound experience.
🏎️ Gameplay & Racing Fixes  Fixed an issue where the Lap Count was inconsistent between clients.  Fixed an issue where the Race Completion Order was incorrect.  Fixed an issue where player names were missing in race results.  Improved Checkpoint Collision Handling for better accuracy.  Fixed player count validation to prevent incorrect session tracking.  Implemented Asynchronous Physics Tick on checkpoints for better performance.  Fixed vehicle substepping issues to improve movement accuracy.  Removed unnecessary bump mesh for a cleaner environment on Skatepark.
🎥 UI & Spectator Mode Enhancements  Implemented new Spectator Input system for smoother controls.  Fixed spectator-related bugs causing UI issues.  Implemented HUD for Spectator and Warm-Up phases.  Fixed missing or incorrect Spectator Texts.
🌍 Multiplayer & Session Improvements  Fixed a bug where the host leaving the game caused session instability.  Fixed an issue where players leaving the game weren’t correctly handled.  Fixed a bug where players were already in session when joining a new one.  Fixed an issue with race complete widget not spawning properly.
📌 Main Menu & Lobby Fixes  Fixed Main Menu Lobby Camera positioning and visibility.  Fixed an issue with vehicle selection visuals not updating in the lobby.  Improved Lobby Creation System to ensure correct initialization.  Implemented Settings Menu UI for more customization options.
⚙️ Additional Fixes & Tweaks  Fixed an issue with reversed air controls and UI misalignment.  Removed "P" key for Pause to prevent conflicts with input mappings.  Hotfix applied to level-specific issues and new input system changes.
⚠️ Known Bugs  If the Host leaves in gameplay, players cannot join any other session.    
✅ Temporary Fix: Host a Lobby and leave. This will fix the join problem for now.    On the Skatepark map, some ramps cause vehicles to be thrown off.    
🛠️ A fix for this is coming tomorrow!
